summary: The exact candidate is test-only hardening for fused ModelOpt-style QKV shard routing. It changes no runtime source and tests a hypothesis the original BF16 issue explicitly ruled out. The real reload path still passes a mapped, differently laid-out tensor unchanged to an ordinary two-argument loader and raises the same empty AssertionError on the base and candidate.

tests.what_was_measured: The candidate's two fused-QKV fixture tests pass; this confirms its test behavior but not the original BF16 layout mismatch.

At the recorded base, img_in.weight mapped to x_embedder.weight and a (2,3) disk tensor passed unchanged to a (3,2) ordinary loader, reproducing the empty AssertionError. The script treats observing that expected failure as success.

The same mapped layout mismatch remains on the exact candidate. A separate exact-name Q projection loaded by identity, demonstrating that BF16 separate-QKV parameters bypass the fused mapping tested by the candidate.
On AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950, GPU-resident mapped tensors still reached the ordinary loader without reconciliation and produced the empty AssertionError.

gpu_execution.evidence: Single GPU execution reported AMD Instinct MI350X and gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-. Both parameter and loaded tensor were on cuda:0; the remaining bare AssertionError was observed. See raw/gpu-adversarial.log.

remaining_counterexamples: A diffusers/BFL name such as img_in.weight maps to x_embedder.weight, but any required transpose or reshape is still not applied before the ordinary two-argument weight_loader.
BF16 FLUX.2 separate to_q/to_k/to_v parameters use the exact-name identity path; they do not exercise or benefit from the candidate's fused-QKV regression.
The secondary text-encoder reload problem and real-checkpoint silent drops are not covered by the candidate.
The ROCm update_weights_from_disk test remains explicitly skipped pending issue 31924.
remaining_limitations: Qwen-Image and FLUX.2-klein-base-4B weights were unavailable, so no full-model boot or HTTP 400 replay was performed.
The focused fixture establishes the unchanged mapping/layout failure contract but cannot identify the exact historical checkpoint tensor.
No tensor-parallel, offload, FSDP, multi-GPU, or multi-node path was exercised.
The candidate changes no native source, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
